title: Pip and the Dots
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: A little trail-of-clues story where the clue itself — a dropped dot-shaped seed — is also a fully decodable word, so look out for a fun double meaning.

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sitting on the rim of a window box full of plants, looking down.
Pip hopping down to pick up a small round seed lying on the soil of the window box.

pages.text: Pip got a dot. Pip got a dot.
pages.illustration: Pip following a scattered trail of small round seeds along the edge of the window box.

pages.text: Pip did nip at a dot.
pages.illustration: Pip pecking curiously at one more small round seed at the end of the trail.
Pip arriving at a large plant pot at the end of the seed trail, sitting on its rim.
Moss the hedgehog revealed curled up behind the plant pot, surrounded by dropped seeds, looking sheepish.

pages.text: Pip and Moss sat. Pip and Moss did nap.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog settled together beside the pot, both dozing contentedly.
